name: whip
description: Slap your MacBook, whip Claude Code: hooks deliver the whip to Claude, the status line shows it, /slaps keeps score.

sound.title: Whip crack sound
sound.description: Plays a crack on every hit. 'whip config' keeps what /whip:config chose.

voice.title: Claude yelps out loud
voice.description: macOS `say` speaks a line on slaps and WALLOPs.

reaction.title: Claude's emoji reaction in chat
reaction.description: The one-line in-character flinch (e.g. (°ロ°;) …) Claude opens its next message with.

banner.title: Whip banner in chat
banner.description: The 💥 WHIP / WALLOP line Claude Code prints when a whip lands.

personality.title: Personality
personality.description: Faces, lines and voice of the whipped Claude.

hardWhip.title: WALLOP interrupts Claude
hardWhip.description: How a WALLOP reaches a busy Claude: typed into tmux, via osascript, or not at all.

lane.title: Whip lane
lane.description: hide = /whip:hide (pause and hide the status line lane and desktop band).
